NONE: › with complete authority, or said by the Pope to be true and so accepted by all members of the Roman Catholic Church
權威性的；來自權威方面的；（教皇諭旨）一貫判斷正確的
› An ex gratia payment is not necessary, especially legally, but is made to show good intentions.
（尤指並非出於法律義務而）作為恩惠的，出於善意的，出於幫助的

example: Ex gratia payments were made to all those who had been affected by the spillage.
受到外泄事故影響的所有人都得到額外賠償。

NONE: › because of a person's position in a formal group
出於職務的；出於職權的；當然的

example: The cabinet members will also attend the meeting ex-officio.
內閣成員理所當然也要出席這個會議。

NONE: › happening or existing outside a living body
離體的，在活體外；取自活體的

example: We've gone ex-directory because we were receiving so many unwanted calls.
我們已經把號碼從電話號碼簿中取消了，因為經常是接到打錯的電話。
